catches: $100 tier requires new checking account with promo code 5002026CK and $25 minimum opening deposit.
$200 debit tier: 40 qualifying debit card purchase transactions within 60 days of account opening; ATM, P2P, returns and non-purchase transactions do not count.
$200 DD tier: recurring ACH direct deposits totaling at least $500 per month within 60 days; Zelle/P2P and account transfers do not qualify.
Account must be open, active, and unrestricted at payout.
Bonuses reported to IRS as interest.
Offer unavailable to existing HCCU checking holders and members whose checking closed within the previous 90 days or with a negative balance.
CA eligibility: Sacramento, Placer, El Dorado, Yolo, and San Joaquin Counties, or CA residents who are members of the Financial Fitness Association (per Doctor of Credit crawl of offer terms).
